name: Breaking Bad
description: A chemistry teacher diagnosed with inoperable lung cancer turns to manufacturing and selling methamphetamine with a former student to secure his family's future.

videos.name: Pilot
videos.overview: When an unassuming high school chemistry teacher discovers he has a rare form of lung cancer, he decides to team up with a former student and create a top of the line crystal meth in a used RV, to provide for his family once he is gone.

videos.name: Cat's in the Bag...
videos.overview: Walt and Jesse attempt to tie up loose ends. The desperate situation gets more complicated with the flip of a coin. Walt's wife, Skyler, becomes suspicious of Walt's strange behavior.

videos.name: ...And the Bag's in the River
videos.overview: Walter fights with Jesse over his drug use, causing him to leave Walter alone with their captive, Krazy-8. Meanwhile, Hank has a scared straight moment with Walter Jr..

videos.name: Cancer Man
videos.overview: Walter finally tells his family that he has cancer. Meanwhile, the DEA believes Albuquerque has a new, big time player to worry about. Jesse makes a surprise visit to his parents home.

videos.name: Gray Matter
videos.overview: Walter and Skyler attend a former colleague's birthday party. Jesse tries to free himself from drugs, while Skyler organizes an intervention.

videos.name: A No-Rough-Stuff-Type Deal
videos.overview: Walter accepts his new identity as a drug dealer. Elsewhere, Jesse decides to put his aunt's house on the market and Marie throws Skyler a baby shower.

videos.name: Crazy Handful of Nothin'
videos.overview: The side effects of chemo begin to plague Walt. Meanwhile, the DEA rounds up suspected dealers.

videos.name: Seven Thirty-Seven
videos.overview: Walt and Jesse are reminded of Tuco’s volatile nature, and try to figure a way out of their business partnership. Hank attempts to mend fences between the estranged Marie and Skyler.

videos.name: Grilled
videos.overview: Walt and Jesse find themselves in close quarters with an unhinged Tuco. Marie and Hank comfort Skyler, who is distraught over Walt’s disappearance. Hank pays a visit to Mrs. Pinkman on some not-so-official business.

videos.name: Bit by a Dead Bee
videos.overview: Walt and Jesse cover their tracks, but as a result, both of their financial situations suffer. Meanwhile, Hank and his DEA colleagues may have a break in their meth investigation.

videos.name: Down
videos.overview: Walt tries to reconnect with his family. Still suspicious of her husband's actions, Skyler keeps her distance. Jesse finds himself without a place to live and struggles to cope.

videos.name: Breakage
videos.overview: Tensions and bills mount at the White household. Hank makes progress at work, but struggles with some residual effects from his encounter with Tuco. Jesse assembles a crew of dealers to get their product out on the streets.

videos.name: Peekaboo
videos.overview: Walt returns to work. Skinny Pete gets ripped off and when Jesse steps in, he gets more than he bargained for. Walt's cover story on how Elliott and Gretchen are paying for his medical treatment starts to collapse.

videos.name: Negro Y Azul
videos.overview: Rumors fly about Jesse's recent actions as he and Walt discuss expanding their business into new territories. Hank struggles in El Paso. Skyler pursues a new job opportunity. Jesse gets to know his landlord, Jane.

videos.name: Better Call Saul
videos.overview: When Badger gets busted, Walt and Jesse seek the legal advice of a shady attorney, Saul Goodman. Hank returns to Albuquerque, but his troubled mental state and demeanor cause Marie to worry.

videos.name: 4 Days Out
videos.overview: The Whites await news about Walt's cancer treatment progress. Walt and Jesse retreat to the desert for a marathon cook.

videos.name: Over
videos.overview: Walt and Hank get into a fight, and Walt consumes himself with home improvements. Skyler opens up to her boss, Ted. Jane hides her relationship with Jesse from her father.

videos.name: Mandala
videos.overview: Saul proposes a new business partner. Skyler makes a disturbing discovery. Jesse divulges his real profession to Jane.

videos.name: Phoenix
videos.overview: The Whites welcome a new addition. Walter,  Jr. launches a website to aid his struggling family. Jesse's addiction spirals out of control.

videos.name: ABQ
videos.overview: Walt's lies have pushed Skyler to her limit. Jesse self-destructs after a personal blow, forcing Walt to come to his aid. Donald's grief leads to tragedy.

videos.name: No Mas
videos.overview: As Walt copes with the aftermath of the plane crash and Skyler's anger, Jesse comes to a new realization. A new adversary tracks the elusive Heisenberg. Skyler seeks advice on the state of her marriage and confronts Walt.

videos.name: Caballo Sin Nombre
videos.overview: Walt takes drastic action to bring his family back together. With Saul's help, Jesse makes an unexpected investment.

videos.name: I.F.T.
videos.overview: Walt ignores Skyler's demands, furthering the rift between them. Hank crosses a line at work.

videos.name: Green Light
videos.overview: Walt loses control. Hank throws himself into his blue meth investigation. Jesse enacts a new plan.

videos.name: Mas
videos.overview: Gus tries to lure Walt back into business, forcing a rift between Walt and Jesse. Skyler doubts her new relationship. Marie confides in Skyler about her concern for Hank's well-being.

videos.name: Sunset
videos.overview: As Walt settles into his new surroundings, Walter, Jr. demands answers about his parents' relationship. Hank's investigation creates an immediate problem for Walt and Jesse.

videos.name: One Minute
videos.overview: Hank's increasing volatility forces a confrontation with Jesse and trouble at work. Skyler pressures Walt to make a deal. Gus' actions have severe consequences.

videos.name: I See You
videos.overview: The family waits for news about Hank. While Jesse covers at the lab, Walt attempts to placate Gus.

videos.name: Kafkaesque
videos.overview: As Hank's hospital bills stack up, Skyler hatches a plan. Walt and Gus come to a better understanding. Jesse pursues a new opportunity.

videos.name: Fly
videos.overview: Walt becomes obsessed with a contaminant in the lab. A frustrated Jesse attempts to get Walt back on track.

videos.name: Abiquiu
videos.overview: Skyler gets more involved in Walt's business. Hank struggles with his recovery. Jesse takes an active role in his new enterprise, leading him to a startling discovery.

videos.name: Half Measures
videos.overview: Jesse lashes out. Fearing for Jesse's safety, Walt takes drastic action to intervene. A tragic event leads to a shocking confrontation.

videos.name: Full Measure
videos.overview: With Jesse on the run, Walt negotiates a bargain with Gus and concocts a plan to provide for his and Jesse's safety.

videos.name: Box Cutter
videos.overview: Walt and Jesse face the deadly consequences of their actions. Skyler deals with a puzzling disappearance, as Marie struggles to help Hank with his recovery.

videos.name: Good Cop Bad Cop
videos.overview: Hank and Marie try to spice up their relationship on Valentine's Day.

videos.name: Wedding Day
videos.overview: Walt and Hank have a talk before Hank gets married.

videos.name: TwaughtHammer
videos.overview: Jesse and Badger make a behind the scenes video about their band "TwaughtHammer" and show a music video for their song "Fallacies."

videos.name: Marie's Confession
videos.overview: Marie records a video diary.

videos.name: The Break-In
videos.overview: Badger uses his lock-picking skills to help Walt (AKA Heisenberg) with some "B&E".

videos.name: Thirty-Eight Snub
videos.overview: Walt attempts to form a new alliance as he plans his next move. Skyler pushes Walt towards a business opportunity, in hopes of protecting the family.

videos.name: Open House
videos.overview: Events spiral out of control at Jesse’s place. Skyler reluctantly asks for Saul’s help. Marie returns to an old pastime and a friend asks Hank for help.

videos.name: Bullet Points
videos.overview: The Cartel takes steps to gain the upper hand. Walt and Skyler share an embarrassing secret with the rest of the family. Jesse’s activities draw unwanted attention.

videos.name: Shotgun
videos.overview: When Jesse goes missing, Walt fears the worst. Skyler has an unlikely reunion. Hank shares some bad news with Detective Tim Roberts.

videos.name: Cornered
videos.overview: Skyler makes an unsettling discovery. Walter, Jr. pushes his dad into a questionable purchase. Jesse offers Mike some unexpected help.

videos.name: Problem Dog
videos.overview: A frustrated Walt gambles on a risky new plan.  Skyler's business venture hits a snag.  Hank recruits Walter, Jr. for an unusual outing.

videos.name: Hermanos
videos.overview: Skyler develops an unusual solution to her money troubles. Hank enlists Walt to investigate a theory. Walt’s impatience with Jesse grows.

videos.name: Bug
videos.overview: Skyler's past mistakes come back to haunt her. Gus takes action to thwart his rivals. Jesse seeks Walt's help, with mixed results.

videos.name: Salud
videos.overview: Walt's family worries when he doesn't turn up for Walter, Jr.'s 16th birthday.  Jesse is forced to put his lab skills to the test without Walt's help.

videos.name: Crawl Space
videos.overview: Walt takes drastic action to protect his secret and Gus. Skyler's efforts to solve Ted's financial problems hit a wall.

videos.name: End Times
videos.overview: Hank pushes Gomez to pursue one last lead, while Walt struggles to protect the family. Jesse gets alarming news and rushes to meet with Walt.

videos.name: Face Off
videos.overview: Walt and Jesse team up to take on Gus. With Saul's help, Walt finds an unexpected ally.

videos.name: Live Free or Die
videos.overview: As Walt deals with the aftermath of the Casa Tranquila explosion, Hank works to wrap up his investigation of Gus' empire.

videos.name: Madrigal
videos.overview: Walt and Jesse seek out an unlikely partner for a new business venture. The DEA follows up new leads in its investigation.

videos.name: Hazard Pay
videos.overview: Walt and Jesse put a business plan into action. Walt confesses a secret to Marie.

videos.name: Fifty-One
videos.overview: Walt celebrates another birthday. Skyler considers her options. An associate complicates Walt and Jesse's plan.

videos.name: Dead Freight
videos.overview: Walt's team must get creative to obtain the materials they need to continue their operation.

videos.name: Buyout
videos.overview: Walt, Jesse, and Mike struggle over the future of their business, as occupational hazards weigh on Jesse.

videos.name: Say My Name
videos.overview: Walt takes control of business matters as Mike grapples with the consequences of his actions.

videos.name: Gliding Over All
videos.overview: Walt ties up loose ends. Seeing the evidence of his success, he makes a startling and dangerous decision.

videos.name: Blood Money
videos.overview: As Walt and Jesse adjust to life out of the business, Hank grapples with a troubling lead.

videos.name: Buried
videos.overview: While Skyler's past catches up with her, Walt covers his tracks. Jesse continues to struggle with his guilt.

videos.name: Confessions
videos.overview: Jesse decides to make a change, while Walt and Skyler try to deal with an unexpected demand.

videos.name: Rabid Dog
videos.overview: An unusual strategy starts to bear fruit, while plans are set in motion that could change everything.

videos.name: To'hajiilee
videos.overview: Things heat up for Walt in unexpected ways.

videos.name: Ozymandias
videos.overview: Everyone copes with radically changed circumstances.

videos.name: Granite State
videos.overview: Events set in motion long ago move toward a conclusion.

videos.name: Felina
videos.overview: All bad things must come to an end.

name: Dark
description: A family saga with a supernatural twist, set in a German town where the disappearance of two young children exposes the relationships among four families.

videos.name: Secrets
videos.overview: In 2019, a local boy's disappearance stokes fear in the residents of Winden, a small German town with a strange and tragic history.

videos.name: Lies
videos.overview: When a grim discovery leaves the police baffled, Ulrich seeks a search warrant for the power plant. A mysterious stranger checks into the hotel.

videos.name: Past and Present
videos.overview: It's 1986, and Ulrich's brother, Mads, has been missing for a month. Confusion reigns as past and present intertwine.

videos.name: Double Lives
videos.overview: Bizarre occurrences give Charlotte a sense of déjà vu, and she suspects Peter is hiding something. Franziska snaps when Magnus confronts her.

videos.name: Truths
videos.overview: Hannah takes her obsession with Ulrich too far. The stranger asks Regina to deliver an important package. Martha is torn between Jonas and Bartosz.

videos.name: Sic Mundus Creatus Est
videos.overview: Ulrich looks to the past for answers and dredges up disturbing family secrets. Armed with new tools, Jonas probes the cave's murky depths.

videos.name: Crossroads
videos.overview: Ulrich questions a frail and frightened Helge in the nursing home. Jonas searches for Mikkel, but the stranger warns him about meddling with the past.

videos.name: As You Sow, so You Shall Reap
videos.overview: In 1953, the disfigured bodies of two boys are exhumed at a construction site, the future location of Winden's nuclear power plant.

videos.name: Everything Is Now
videos.overview: Ulrich runs afoul of the law, Helge tries to dodge Egon Tiedemann, Claudia harnesses the cave's powers, and Katharina lashes out at Hannah.

videos.name: Alpha and Omega
videos.overview: Peter gets a shock. Jonas learns the truth about his family, but there are more surprises still to come. Helge makes a sacrifice.

videos.name: Beginnings and Endings
videos.overview: Six months after the disappearances, the police form a task force. In 2052, Jonas learns that most of Winden perished in an apocalyptic event.

videos.name: Dark Matter
videos.overview: Clausen and Charlotte interview Regina. The Stranger takes Hannah to 1987, where Claudia has an unnerving encounter and Egon visits an old nemesis.

videos.name: Ghosts
videos.overview: In 1954, a missing Helge returns, but he'll only speak to Noah. In 1987, Claudia brings the time machine to Tannhaus, and Egon questions Ulrich again.

videos.name: The Travelers
videos.overview: Jonas meets an ominous figure. While the kids comb the cave for answers, the adults gather in the bunker to share what they know about the travelers.

videos.name: Lost and Found
videos.overview: In 1987, Ulrich seizes an opportunity. The kids return to the cave with the time machine, and Jonas learns of a loophole that could change the future.

videos.name: An Endless Cycle
videos.overview: Armed with a plan to prevent the apocalypse, Jonas travels to 2019. During the Nielsens' anniversary party, Ulrich sneaks off with Hannah.

videos.name: The White Devil
videos.overview: Martha meets the Stranger and learns his true identity. Claudia tries to prevent Egon's death in 1987. Hannah travels to 1954 to see Ulrich.

videos.name: Endings and Beginnings
videos.overview: On the day of the apocalypse, Clausen executes a search warrant at the power plant as Jonas and Claudia use the time machine to connect past and future.

videos.name: Deja-vu
videos.overview: In 2019, Jonas emerges from the cave into a strange but familiar world: the town of Winden, reeling from the recent disappearance of a young boy.

videos.name: The Survivors
videos.overview: Martha travels to 1888 to warn her friends about the 2020 disaster. Winden residents past and present search for their missing loved ones.

videos.name: Adam and Eva
videos.overview: Charlotte and Ulrich try to piece together what happened in the bunker. In different times and worlds, Jonas and Martha work to gain each other's trust.

videos.name: The Origin
videos.overview: Martha and Jonas travel to 2052 and get a glimpse of a grim future. In 1954, two residents of Winden go missing, and Hannah receives surprising news.

videos.name: Life and Death
videos.overview: In 2020, a visitor delivers a warning to Claudia. The day before the apocalypse, Jonas begins to question Eva's motives.

videos.name: Light and Shadow
videos.overview: Adam holds Martha captive in 2020. On the day of the apocalypse, an increasingly frantic Martha begs Bartosz for his help.

videos.name: Between the Time
videos.overview: Across three centuries, Winden's residents continue their desperate quest to alter their fate and save their loved ones.

videos.name: The Paradise
videos.overview: Claudia reveals to Adam how everything is connected — and how he can destroy the knot.

videos.overview: In the year 849, Jean Kirschtein returns home for the first time in years after training with Armin and Annie. However, he is distracted by Sasha, Connie, and Reiner, as well as Commander Pyxis.

videos.name: Distress
videos.overview: In the year 848, Eren and the other recruits take part in a training exercise. Split into two teams, their task is to make a round trip, recording progress along the way and exchanging information at the target location before returning to base. However, things do not go according to plan...

videos.name: Attack on Titan Part I: Crimson Bow and Arrow
videos.overview: First of three recap movies.

videos.name: No Regrets (1)
videos.overview: Levi, currently living in the Underground as a crime boss, is given a choice; either be turned over to the Military Police and be tried for his crimes, or join the Recon Corps...

videos.name: Attack on Titan (Live Action Movie)
videos.overview: A teenage boy named Eren Jaeger must use his special gift to fight alongside with the military to defeat the titan race. Mankind is on the brink of extinction when these man-eating monsters terrorize everybody and set to destroy the last of human civilization left in the world.

videos.name: No Regrets (2)
videos.overview: Levi joins the Recon Corps to escape punishment for his past crimes. But with the looming challenges and preparations for their first expedition beyond the Wall, will Levi and his friends carry out their mysterious ulterior motives concerning Erwin Smith?

videos.name: Attack on Titan Part II: Wings of Freedom
videos.overview: Second of three recap movies.

videos.name: Attack on Titan II - End of the World (Live Action Movie)
videos.overview: A continuation of the ongoing battle between the Scouting Regiment and the Titans. As the battle continues to unravel, Eren Jäeger, a soldier fighting the Titans for vengeance, is finding out an incredible secret that'll leave the whole Scouting Regiment confused, but unsure on what to do and if it's really Eren. Will the Scouting Regiment realize what he is and will they be able to stop the Titans?

videos.name: Lost Girls: Wall Sina, Goodbye (1)
videos.overview: On the day before the 57th Exterior Scouting Mission, Hitch gives Annie Leonhart the task of finding a missing person, Carly Stratmann, the daughter of a wealthy merchant in Stohess District. She visits the Stratmann family mansion to ask Carly's father, Elliot G. Stratmann, about the circumstances that may be related to her disappearance.

videos.name: Attack on Titan Part III: The Roar of Awakening
videos.overview: The third recap movie, compiling episodes 26-37 of the anime.

videos.name: Lost Girls: Wall Sina, Goodbye (2)
videos.overview: After finding Carly's boyfriend dead, Annie decides to cover up his murder and locate Carly Stratmann to prevent the case from interfering with her mission. On her way back she is kidnapped by two private investigators who've gone rogue.

videos.name: Lost Girls: Lost in the Cruel World
videos.overview: Mikasa Ackerman imagines a world where the Titans never invaded the Walls and her parents are not killed by her kidnappers. This Mikasa of an alternate world meets a young boy, Eren Yeager, and learns of his desire to see the outside world.

Attack on Titan ~ Chronicle ~
videos.overview: A re-edited version of the first to third seasons of the TV anime series "Attack on Titan", a blockbuster comic by Hajime Isayama. Before the broadcast of "The Final Season", which is the final part of the TV series, it was drawn in 59 episodes of all three seasons of Season 1 in 2013, Season 2 in 2017, and Season 3 broadcast from 18 to 19. In a story-telling composition, it follows the battle and growth of the boy Eren Yeager, who vowed to destroy all the giants from the day the wall that protects humanity was broken by the invasion of the giants. Yuki Kaji as the main character Ellen, Yui Ishikawa as Mikasa Ackerman, and Marina Inoue as Armin Arlert will also be the narrators.

videos.overview: A special recap re-edited Seasons 1 to 3 of "Attack on Titan". The second night, will consist of Reiner Brown and Bertolt Hoover, who hold the key to the story, and Annie Leonhart and Ymir.

videos.name: Attack on Titan The Final Season SPECIAL EVENT 2022
videos.overview:
“Attack on Titan The Final Season SPECIAL EVENT 2022” was held on November 13, 2022, at Tachikawa Stage Garden in Tokyo. The event was divided into two parts.

The first part featured an orchestral concert led by composer Kohta Yamamoto, with guest vocalists including Yuko Ando, Ai Higuchi, mpi, Laco (EOW), cumi (BINJU), Hannah Grace, and KAREN.

The second part was a special talk show with voice actors Yuki Kaji (Eren), Yui Ishikawa (Mikasa), Marina Inoue (Armin), Hiro Shimono (Connie), Kishō Taniyama (Jean), Romi Park (Hange), and Ayane Sakura (Gabi), moderated by Chiaki Matsuzawa.

The event celebrated the world of Attack on Titan: The Final Season through music and live discussion, offering fans a unique and memorable experience.

videos.name: To You, in 2,000 Years: The Fall of Shiganshina (1)
videos.overview: After one hundred years of peace, humanity is suddenly reminded of the terror of being at the Titans' mercy.

videos.name: That Day: The Fall of Shiganshina (2)
videos.overview: After the Titans break through the wall, the citizens of Shiganshina must run for their lives. However, those that do make it to safety find a harsh life waiting for them.

videos.name: A Dim Light Amid Despair: Humanity's Comeback (1)
videos.overview: Eren begins his training with the Cadet Corps, but questions about his painful past overwhelm him. When he struggles with a maneuvering exercise, Bertholdt and Reiner offer kindly advice.

videos.name: The Night of the Closing Ceremony: Humanity's Comeback (2)
videos.overview: Two years pass and the time for the recruits' graduation approaches. Annie proves her skill in a sparring session, Jean dreams of serving alongside the King, and graduation day brings shocking revelations — along with the sudden appearance of an old foe.

videos.name: First Battle: The Struggle for Trost (1)
videos.overview: Five years have passed since the fall of Wall Maria and Eren faces off against the Colossal Titan after it appears out of nowhere once again, and knocks a strategic hole in the gate of Wall Rose. As Titans swarm the city, the newly graduated Cadets are called in to fight a brutal battle that won't be without casualties.

videos.name: The World the Girl Saw: The Struggle for Trost (2)
videos.overview: Armin tries to cope with the loss of his friends and allies after Titans massacre his squad. Elsewhere in the city, Mikasa manages to take out several of the monsters, which brings back tragic memories of her past and the first time she met Eren.

videos.name: Small Blade: The Struggle for Trost (3)
videos.overview: After the retreat bell sounds, many cadets find themselves without enough fuel to scale the wall back to safety. Mikasa begins to lose hope once she hears of the deaths in Armin's squad, but the appearance of a new type of Titan stokes her will to fight.

videos.name: I Can Hear His Heartbeat: The Struggle for Trost (4)
videos.overview: Armin comes up with a risky plan that pits Titan against Titan as the abandoned cadets attempt to take back their headquarters. Getting into the building might be possible, but getting out alive and refueled will mean facing more of the giants.

videos.name: Whereabouts of His Left Arm: The Struggle for Trost (5)
videos.overview: A miraculous return is met with anger and fear. Cannons are fixed on Eren as he struggles to remember what happened to him inside the belly of a Titan and how he ended up as humankind's enemy. One question is all that matters: is Eren human or Titan?

videos.name: Response: The Struggle for Trost (6)
videos.overview: Cadets respond to Eren's terrifying transformation with doubt and fear as he struggles to understand it himself. If Armin can't talk the commander into using Eren's newfound powers for the good of humankind, all hope of stopping the Titans might be lost.

videos.name: Idol: The Struggle for Trost (7)
videos.overview: Plans are made to use Eren's Titan powers to seal the hole in the wall in an attempt reclaim Trost. But with the government's bloodstained history and vocal dissenters in the military ranks, the biggest threat to humankind may not be the Titans.

videos.name: Wound: The Struggle for Trost (8)
videos.overview: The plan to reclaim Trost falls apart when Eren’s newfound powers turn him into a mindless giant. As Titans continue to swarm the city, it’s up to Armin and Mikasa to make sure the cadets massacred during the mission haven’t died in vain.

videos.name: Primal Desire: The Struggle for Trost (9)
videos.overview: Jean takes desperate measures to replace his broken Maneuver Gear. Meanwhile, Eren is able to seal the hole in the wall thanks to the help of his fellow cadets, but the cost of humanity’s first victory against the Titans will be enormous.

videos.name: Can't Look into His Eyes Yet: Eve of the Counterattack (1)
videos.overview: A special military tribunal will decide Eren’s fate. The Military Police calls for his execution while the Recon Corps argues that he is a powerful resource for humankind, and Mikasa is put on the spot when asked about the events of the Trost mission.

videos.name: Special Operations Squad: Eve of the Counterattack (2)
videos.overview: The Recon Corps moves Eren to an old abandoned castle where he will continue his training. Hanzi visits and reveals that she’s been putting two captured Titans through a series of tests and trials — experiments that she wants Eren’s help with.

videos.name: What Needs to Be Done Now: Eve of the Counterattack (3)
videos.overview: Everyone is a suspect in the investigation to find out who killed the two test-subject Titans. Meanwhile, the cadets pick which military branch they’ll be joining, but after the harrowing events in the Trost attack, many are uncertain which branch to choose.

videos.name: Female Titan: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (1)
videos.overview: As the Recon Corps begins its push toward Shiganshina, they encounter an intelligent Female Titan unlike any they’ve seen before. When Armin hypothesizes that it’s really a human that’s been turned into a Titan, he, Jean, and Reiner attempt to stop it.

videos.name: Forest of Giant Trees: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (2)
videos.overview: As the Female Titan continues to tear its way through the Recon Corps, Levi makes a bold decision to split the ranks and send Eren and the supply wagons through a huge forest. Is his strategy genius, or does it spell certain death for the scouts?

videos.name: Bite: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (3)
videos.overview: With the Female Titan still chasing after Levi's squad, Eren considers turning himself into his Titan form, but Levi tells him to choose to be either a monster or a member of the Recon Corps. As Eren remembers what he has learned from the squad, he realizes that the danger and sacrifice they all share is not what binds them — it is trust. Now it is up to Eren to make the decision of who he will trust.

videos.name: Erwin Smith: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (4)
videos.overview: With the help of Levi's squad, the Recon Corps has successfully captured the Female Titan. As Commander Erwin and Captain Levi begin preparations to extract whoever is inside the Titan, will the Recon Corps discover its true identity, or does the Female Titan have one last trick up its sleeve?

videos.name: Crushing Blow: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (5)
videos.overview: After a last act of desperation, the person inside the Female Titan has escaped from the Recon Corps and reverted to their human form. Now, disguised as a member of the Recon Corps and equipped with Maneuver Gear, they finally catch up to their prey — Levi's squad.

videos.name: The Defeated: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (6)
videos.overview: The Female Titan has captured Eren after ripping him out of his Titan body, but Mikasa and Captain Levi give chase. Elsewhere, the Recon Corps begins preparations for the journey back home to the Wall with their numerous dead in tow.

videos.name: Smile: Assault on Stohess (1)
videos.overview: Following the disastrous results of the 57th Expedition, Eren is to be brought to the King's palace for a court martial. Armin, desperate to save Eren from certain execution, enlists the help of an old friend to assist with an escape plan.

videos.name: Mercy: Assault on Stohess (2)
videos.overview: With the identity of the Female Titan now revealed, Eren has reservations about fighting her. Mikasa, Armin, and the rest of the Recon Corps try to fight the Female Titan, hoping to distract her long enough to buy Eren time to come to terms with his feelings.

videos.name: Wall: Assault on Stohess (3)
videos.overview: Eren, spurred on by his promise to kill every single Titan, unleashes the full power of his Titan form in the fight with the Female Titan. As their bloody battle draws to a close, it seems humanity may finally have a chance at survival. However, with many mysteries still left unsolved, what will await Eren, Mikasa, and Armin?

videos.name: Beast Titan
videos.overview: Coupled with the military's cover-up of a previous incident, the shocking discovery inside the Walls causes a stir. Elsewhere, while the new Scout recruits are held for observation, a surprising threat appears.

videos.name: I'm Home
videos.overview: With the appearance of Titans within Wall Rose, Sasha and Connie ride as messengers to warn their villages of the impending threat.

videos.name: Southwestward
videos.overview: Scouts search for a hole in the wall while Eren and others learn that someone close knows all the answers.

videos.name: Soldier
videos.overview: Unarmed and overwhelmed by the Titan assault on the castle, the only hope for the Scouts may lie in a promise and a secret.

videos.name: Historia
videos.overview: Utgard Castle comes crumbling down as Ymir desperately battles the Titans. Now, Christa must fulfill the promise they made long ago during winter training.

videos.name: Warrior
videos.overview: Following the battle, the Scouts regroup atop the wall only to find more questions than answers.

videos.name: Close Combat
videos.overview: With a new enemy revealed, Eren and the Scouts fight back using all the techniques at their disposal.

videos.name: The Hunters
videos.overview: Without a way to pursue the Titans, the Scouts have no choice but to recuperate as they wait for reinforcements. But do they still have faith in Eren?

videos.name: Opening
videos.overview: The Scouts rally and charge in pursuit, but Reiner is not quite himself while the group is trapped in the giant forest until nightfall.

videos.name: Children
videos.overview: When their group finally flees, Ymir wonders whether she should lie or stay true to herself, even if it means ruining the lives and future of those she cares about.

videos.name: Charge
videos.overview: The pursuit begins as the Recon Corps battles their way to Eren. But as the Scouts start to take numerous casualties, Erwin executes a risky strategy.

videos.name: Scream
videos.overview: The battle continues as Eren and the Scouts face many hard decisions. Who is the real enemy? What is the war really about? And what will the future hold for mankind?

videos.name: Smoke Signal
videos.overview: After barely surviving Eren's recovery, a rising threat from the shadows puts everyone's lives in danger again.

videos.name: Pain
videos.overview: The Scouts take a stand against a new enemy, but it's not just Titans they'll be fighting anymore.

videos.name: Old Story
videos.overview: Historia and Erwin look back on their past, revealing a shady government with a hidden agenda and inspiration for an uprising.

videos.name: Trust
videos.overview: On the run and running out of time, the Scouts must entrust their lives to others if they plan on surviving.

videos.name: Reply
videos.overview: Erwin pleads his case for the Scouts to be spared, but an unforeseen announcement puts the fate of humanity at risk.

videos.name: Sin
videos.overview: While sins of the past reveal new truths, both sides prepare for the upcoming showdown before they run out of time.

videos.name: Wish
videos.overview: As battle breaks out, Historia makes a shocking decision which leads to catastrophe.

videos.name: Outside the Walls of Orvud District
videos.overview: When everything falls apart, Eren must believe in himself to save his friends. But Eren alone may not be enough to stop the impending doom.

videos.name: Ruler of the Walls
videos.overview: The survey corps and the wall garrison must protect the Orvud District from the impending attack of Rod Reiss's titan.

videos.name: Friends
videos.overview: Kenny recalls the life which has brought him to death's door, but he gets to decide whether to live on or not.

videos.name: Bystander
videos.overview: Having seen a glimpse of his father's memories, Eren attempts to track down a man hoping they might shed some light on his father's secrets.

videos.name: Night of the Battle to Retake the Wall
videos.overview: The Scouts gather for a feisty feast before leaving to retake Wall Maria to uncover what's hidden in the basement once and for all.

videos.name: The Town Where Everything Began
videos.overview: The operation to retake Wall Maria commences in Shiganshina, the town where everything began. But when the Scouts arrive, something seems very wrong.

videos.name: Thunder Spears
videos.overview: Against a rush of enemies, the Scouts scramble to defend their horses. But despite falling into a trap, they have their own surprise for the Armored Titan.

videos.name: Descent
videos.overview: Though their Thunder Spears prove effective, the Scouts' celebration is short-lived as disaster descends upon Shiganshina.

videos.name: Perfect Game
videos.overview: While one front in the battle is rained on by flames, the other is battered by boulders. With no way out, the Scouts are forced to fight or die trying.

videos.name: Hero
videos.overview: As Erwin's heroic charge buys Levi time to confront the Beast Titan, Armin comes up with a plan of his own that lays it all on the line.

videos.name: Midnight Sun
videos.overview: While picking up the pieces from the costly battle, tensions rise when deciding which of the wounded Scouts gets to use the single syringe of serum.

videos.name: The Basement
videos.overview: The Scouts reflect on all they have gained and lost in their mission. With their enemies gone, Eren and the Scouts finally enter the basement to uncover the truth that will change everything.

videos.name: That Day
videos.overview: A look into Grisha's memories shows Eren the many secrets his father was hiding, including one which led to his mother's demise.

videos.name: Attack Titan
videos.overview: Eren learns the truth about his Titan powers, his Father and himself. The Survey Corps have a meeting that discusses the future of Eldia with all their new information.

videos.name: The Other Side of the Wall
videos.overview: Though it's met with hope and despair, the truth is made public. The Scouts then venture beyond the walls to see if it's everything they dreamed of.

videos.name: The Other Side of the Sea
videos.overview: As Marley battles the Mid-East Alliance to end a four-year war, a group of Warrior candidates on the front lines compete to be the successor of the Armored Titan.

videos.name: Midnight Train
videos.overview: Though glad the war is over, both the Eldian Warriors and Marley brass realize that neither have a future unless they finish the job of retaking the Founding Titan.

videos.name: The Door of Hope
videos.overview: Reiner reflects on his past, remembering what pushed him to become a Warrior and keep moving forward when all hope was lost.

videos.name: From One Hand to Another
videos.overview: A sudden visit from the Tybur family shakes up the Marleyan military. Meanwhile, Falco smuggles letters for a friend and helps two old comrades reunite.

videos.name: Declaration of War
videos.overview: While Willy Tybur reveals the truth in a shocking speech to the world, tensions rise behind the stage as Eren and Reiner meet face to face.

videos.name: The War Hammer Titan
videos.overview: Eren's rampage is thwarted by the War Hammer Titan whose tenacity leaves him stumped. With Marley's military joining the fight, he'll be hard-pressed to survive on his own.

videos.name: Assault
videos.overview: The forces of Paradis begin their assault, but the Warriors stand their ground. As Marley troops close in around them, Eren struggles to break the War Hammer's defenses.

videos.name: Assassin's Bullet
videos.overview: With no Titans left to threaten their escape, the Scouts retreat on the airship. Determined to make them pay for trampling on her home, Gabi chases after with gun in hand.

videos.name: Brave Volunteers
videos.overview: As Paradis deals with the aftermath of the raid on Liberio, Armin looks back in the past to meeting the volunteer soldiers who reshaped their world.

videos.name: A Sound Argument
videos.overview: Two years ago, Paradis welcomed their first visitor who was surprised to see one of their own. Obtaining their help will be critical in a three-part plan to protect Paradis.

videos.name: Deceiver
videos.overview: Trapped on the world's most dangerous island, Falco and Gabi will do anything to survive. Elsewhere, the public demands answers when they learn the savior of Paradis has been detained.

videos.name: Guides
videos.overview: While Hange and Pyxis piece together Zeke's true intentions, tension builds outside HQ where Armin and Mikasa plead for permission to speak with Eren.

videos.name: Children of the Forest
videos.overview: Gabi and Falco seek assistance from the captured Marleyan soldiers. Will their faith in their countrymen be rewarded or betrayed?

videos.name: Savagery
videos.overview: Armin and Mikasa speak with Eren, but are astounded by what he says. In the forest, Levi considers feeding the Beast Titan to someone new, but Zeke has other plans in mind.

videos.name: Sole Salvation
videos.overview: A look into Zeke's past shows his struggle to become a Warrior. His plans to end the suffering of all Eldians stems from a chance friendship made in his youth.

videos.name: Above and Below
videos.overview: With the Jaegerists now in charge, Zeke's master plan is revealed. But before it is put in motion, Eren recruits help to flush out any invaders in their midst.

videos.name: Judgment
videos.overview: The Marleyan military's air force invades Paradis, while Eren Yeager continues battling Porco Galliard, who is soon joined by Reiner Braun in his Armored Titan form.

videos.name: Sneak Attack
videos.overview: The Beast Titan joins the fray, but General Magath is determined to take him down. Meanwhile, with the city in flames, Colt and Gabi rush to rescue Falco who's held captive by the Jaegerists.

videos.name: Two Brothers
videos.overview: Colt pleads with Zeke to not use his scream and turn Falco into a Titan. All the while, soldiers and Titans clash in battle as Eren struggles to make contact with his brother.

videos.name: Memories of the Future
videos.overview: Zeke takes Eren through Grisha's memories to show him how he's been brainwashed. But in doing so, Zeke discovers something about Eren that he never knew.

videos.name: From You, 2,000 Years Ago
videos.overview: This is the story of those who have been resisting, struggling, and continually advancing for 2,000 years. Who the hell started this story? Eren speaks to Founder Ymir, who continues walking, "You were waiting... All this time. For 2,000 years... Waiting for someone..."

videos.name: Thaw
videos.overview: With no walls left on the island and Shiganshina full of Titans, the Scouts must battle their former comrades. In the midst of it all, Gabi is determined to find and rescue Falco at whatever cost.

videos.name: Sunset
videos.overview: The rumbling is set in motion once all hardening is undone, but this also sets Annie free. As the Jaegerists take control of the island, Connie races towards Ragako to feed Falco to his Titan mother.

videos.name: Pride
videos.overview: Upon reaching Ragako, Connie hatches a plan to trick Falco into being eaten by his mother. Elsewhere, hero of the Eldian Empire, Jean, is to execute Yelena and Onyankopon for their crimes against humanity.

videos.name: Night of the End
videos.overview: Deep in the forest, an unlikely rabble of Marley stragglers and island fugitives attempt to set their hatred aside and talk around a campfire without killing each other.

videos.name: Traitor
videos.overview: The Azumabito’s flying boat is guarded by a port full of Jaegerists, but the Scouts are reluctant to kill their former friends. If they wish to avoid bloodshed, they can't afford their plan to go wrong.

videos.name: Retrospective
videos.overview: For the flying boat to take off, the mechanics need half a day to service it. Knowing they'll never last that long with Jaegerist reinforcements on the way, the crew is forced to change their plans.

videos.name: The Dawn of Humanity
videos.overview: Regardless of where it all began, Eren commits to his path of destruction during the Scouts' first visit to the Marleyan mainland, leaving Mikasa to wonder if things could've been different.

videos.name: The Final Chapters: Special 1
videos.overview:
As the rumbling advances, the remaining members of the Scout Regiment race against the clock with their Marleyan and Azumabito allies to catch up to Eren and stop the rumbling before the rest of the world is crushed under the Wall Titans' feet.
- The Rumbling
- The Wings of Freedom
- In The Depths of Despair

videos.overview: Eren, as the Founding Titan, advances on Fort Salta with countless other Titans. Appearing before the refugees, who stand on the brink of despair, are Mikasa, Armin, Jean, Conny, Reiner, Pieck, and Levi, who narrowly escaped from the rumbling. The battle between former comrades and childhood friends with Eren concludes here.
